title: Normal and periodic tracking area updating procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: Tracking Area Update Accepted Procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed when the network accepts a tracking area update request from the UE. The MME sends a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and may assign new GUTI, start timer T3450, and enter state EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the MME to the UE when the tracking area update request is accepted. May contain GUTI, TAI list, EPS bearer context status, and various IEs.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure. Contains various IEs like UE network capability, EPS update type, and DRX parameters.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to acknowledge receipt of GUTI or Negotiated IMSI offset in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity assigned to the UE. Included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT when MME assigns new GUTI.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list provided to the UE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT. MME may include new TAI list for the UE.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: IE indicating which EPS bearer contexts are active. Included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT to inform UE about locally deactivated bearers.

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed
entities.description: IE that triggers MME to delete stored UE radio capability information when included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST.

entities.name: T3450
entities.description: Timer started by MME when GUTI is included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT. Stopped upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE.

entities.name: T3430
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by MME when starting timer T3450 after including GUTI in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by UE upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: GUTI included condition
entities.description: Condition where MME includes GUTI IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message, triggering timer T3450 start and state transition.

entities.name: Delete stored UE radio capability information
entities.description: MME behavior to delete stored UE radio capability information or UE radio capability ID when UE radio capability information update needed IE is included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message to UE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may contain GUTI IE when MME assigns new GUTI.
When GUTI is included in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT, MME starts timer T3450.
When GUTI is included, MME enters state EMM-COMMON-PROCEDURE-INITIATED.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may include TAI list for the UE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST may contain UE radio capability information update needed IE.
Presence of UE radio capability information update needed IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST establishes MME behavior to delete stored UE radio capability information.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may include EPS bearer context status IE to inform UE about active/inactive bearers.
Receipt of TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message stops timer T3450.
UE stops timer T3430 upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
UE enters state EMM-REGISTERED upon receiving TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
